name: India
notes: Ensure passport is valid for at least 6 months beyond arrival.

requirements.traveler: Valid approved electronic or physical visa for India, plus return flight tickets.
requirements.medical: Official hospital invitation letter from a recognized medical institution in India.
requirements.business: Official corporate invitation letter from a registered company in India.
requirements.student: Official admission or acceptance letter from an educational institution in India.
requirements.child: Child must have their own separate passport. For newborns without a passport, apply for an emergency travel document or birth registration certificate along with parental consent affidavits signed by both parents.

requirements.traveler: Original passport with minimum 6 months validity and 2 blank pages, plus National Identity Card (NIC).
requirements.medical: Local medical reports, diagnostic scans, and referral letter from doctor in home country.
requirements.business: Employer covering letter confirming designation, business purpose, and financial guarantee.
requirements.student: Certified academic transcripts, mark sheets, and English language proficiency scores (IELTS/TOEFL).
requirements.child: Child's birth certificate and a notarized parental consent letter if traveling with only one parent or legal guardian.

requirements.traveler: Recent 3 to 6-month personal bank statements proving sufficient funds for stay in India.
requirements.medical: Bank statements from the last 3-6 months or hospital financial guarantee deposit to cover clinical expenses.
requirements.business: Company bank statements (last 3-6 months) and company business registration certificate.
requirements.student: Sponsor's 3-6 month bank statements and formal letter of financial support.
requirements.child: Proof of financial sufficiency covering family and dependent child travel expenses during the trip to India.

requirements.traveler: Valid international travel health insurance covering medical emergencies in India.
requirements.medical: Health fitness certificates and medical clearance documentation required by India health authorities.
requirements.business: Travel insurance policy covering business travel equipment and medical emergencies.
requirements.student: Mandatory student health examination, vaccination records, and medical clearance certificate.
requirements.child: Child vaccination card (including polio, MMR, etc.) and pediatric health clearance certificate for international travel.

requirements.traveler: Confirmed hotel bookings or host accommodation invitation letter with host ID proof.
requirements.medical: Detailed accommodation arrangements near the treating hospital or medical center in India.
requirements.business: Itinerary of business meetings, trade conferences, or exhibition registrations in India.
requirements.student: Proof of university housing or initial accommodation booking upon arrival in India.
requirements.child: Child-friendly accommodation arrangements and confirmed return flight tickets for all accompanying minors.

requirements.business: Employer covering letter confirming designation, business purpose, and financial guarantee.
requirements.student: Certified academic transcripts, mark sheets, and English language proficiency scores (IELTS/TOEFL).
requirements.child: Child's birth certificate and a notarized parental consent letter if traveling with only one parent or legal guardian.

requirements.traveler: Recent 3 to 6-month personal bank statements proving sufficient funds for stay in New Zealand.
requirements.medical: Bank statements from the last 3-6 months or hospital financial guarantee deposit to cover clinical expenses.
requirements.business: Company bank statements (last 3-6 months) and company business registration certificate.
requirements.student: Sponsor's 3-6 month bank statements and formal letter of financial support.
requirements.child: Proof of financial sufficiency covering family and dependent child travel expenses during the trip to New Zealand.

requirements.traveler: Valid international travel health insurance covering medical emergencies in New Zealand.
requirements.medical: Health fitness certificates and medical clearance documentation required by New Zealand health authorities.
requirements.business: Travel insurance policy covering business travel equipment and medical emergencies.
requirements.student: Mandatory student health examination, vaccination records, and medical clearance certificate.
requirements.child: Child vaccination card (including polio, MMR, etc.) and pediatric health clearance certificate for international travel.

requirements.traveler: Confirmed hotel bookings or host accommodation invitation letter with host ID proof.
requirements.medical: Detailed accommodation arrangements near the treating hospital or medical center in New Zealand.
requirements.business: Itinerary of business meetings, trade conferences, or exhibition registrations in New Zealand.
requirements.student: Proof of university housing or initial accommodation booking upon arrival in New Zealand.
requirements.child: Child-friendly accommodation arrangements and confirmed return flight tickets for all accompanying minors.

name: United States
notes: Ensure passport is valid for at least 6 months beyond arrival.

requirements.traveler: Valid approved electronic or physical visa for United States, plus return flight tickets.
requirements.medical: Official hospital invitation letter from a recognized medical institution in United States.
requirements.business: Official corporate invitation letter from a registered company in United States.
requirements.student: Official admission or acceptance letter from an educational institution in United States.
requirements.child: Child must have their own separate passport. For newborns without a passport, apply for an emergency travel document or birth registration certificate along with parental consent affidavits signed by both parents.
